# DE-001 runnerless full-CI revocation probe

Ephemeral CI-only probe for #4990.

This file carries no product, research, qualification, evidence, optimizer, or scientific authority. The child PR exists only to prove that `Draft Full CI Concurrency Revocation` can cancel an already-admitted ready-state `CI` workflow on `converted_to_draft` without allocating a runner and without a follow-up commit.
